#lang beagle/js
(ns conformance.hl-equality-hashing)

;; The corpus runner supplies the smallest deterministic equality/hash probe.
(defn probe [(x Any)] Any x)

rule.text: Equality and hashing are domain-strict and host-independent; unsupported semantic values and non-admissible NaN collection membership use the decided semantic errors.

expected.name: HL-EQUALITY-HASHING-SMALLEST-DETERMINISTIC-CASE
assertions: complete equality matrix for separately allocated hashable atoms and aggregates
exact BeagleHashV1 hashes for equal values
equal values have equal hashes and a fixed collision does not establish equality
map key lookup succeeds across representation and insertion-order changes

assertions.construct: equality-or-hash on mutable cells, capabilities, functions, iterators, foreign/host objects, raw pointers, or Buffers
NaN admitted as a map key or set element
identical? applied to an immutable semantic value
